cells.gaps: Only two of 213 planned CEMAC operator roaming links were live in April 2024; no figures of use, decision of a joint body or review of what was delivered is found.
cells.note: ARTAC reported in April 2024 that roaming links of MTN Cameroon with MTN Congo and of Orange Cameroun with Airtel Gabon were operational under the CEMAC free roaming rules, so something agreed is in effect. No figures of use or review is found, so it is not stage 5.
